snippet.title: Abra-Cooking-Dabra: Announcement trailer
snippet.description: Abra-Cooking-Dabra is a cooking card game where you cook British dishes, farm and manage ingredients and timers in order to meet puzzling orders from guests in a place run by an angry wacky cat somewhere far away in the Wonderland Isles. And how did you even end up there?
